title: はじめての講義
summary: 走ったあとは座る番だ、と教授が言う。講義棟の大ホールで、新入生向けの短い講義があるらしい。席に着いて話を聞き、終わったら教卓の教授に質問してみよう。
summary_en: After running comes sitting, says the professor. There is a short lecture for new students in the main hall of the lecture building. Take a seat and listen, and when it is over, go and ask the professor at the lectern a question.
rewardText: 講義で 1 ビットの考え方を教わった
rewardText_en: You learned to think in bits at the lecture

steps.text_en: Take a seat in the main hall

steps.text: 講義のあと、教卓の教授に質問する
steps.text_en: After the lecture, ask the professor at the lectern a question
